summary: ```markdown # Marvelous Designer Official Tutorial Video: Furniture Item Production (Part 1) ## Introduction Hi everyone! Today we are going to learn how to make furniture in Marvelous Designer. ## Creating the Rectangle 1. **Use the Rectangle Tool**: Start by creating a 500mm x 300mm rectangle in the 2D window. 2. **Switching Tools**: Press and hold the edit tool to switch to the circular line tool. Then, click and drag a point. 3. **Adjusting Corners**: While dragging, press and hold the right button to enter the number of corners. The four corners are operated in the same way. ## Understanding Particle Frame Thickness - You can see that the plate has a thickness. - When creating a default particle frame, the distance between the points is relatively large, and there is not enough grid at the corner, which is not smooth enough. ### Adjusting Particle Frame Properties - If the particle frame is reduced to 3, the grid becomes relatively small, with a larger number of grids for a smoother transition. - The height of the particle frame is slightly increased, while the distance between the points of direction is reduced. - If the particle frame is created, the thickness will be reduced because the particle frame has been made by the texture surface. ### Final Adjustments - The thickness of the particle frame is saved, and adjustments can be made to it as needed. - After applying the density of the signature, adjust the boundary bend (green) to control the angle of the plate. - Remember that the smaller the number, the sharper the angle, while the larger the number results in a smoother transition. ## Assembling the Chair and Cushion Now that we have assembled the chair and cushion with the panels, we need to convert these panels into OBJ format. ### Converting to OBJ - When converting, select the option to convert into OBJ to separate the cushion from the chair. - It is important to separate these panels, as later it will not be possible to wrap them on the outside of each part. ### Converting Remaining Parts - To convert the rest of the parts, again select the option to convert into OBJ. - Once we have the table ready, ensure its position is adjusted as needed. - If all panels are to be converted into OBJ at once, any subsequent editing and moving will become problematic, as they cannot be separated afterward. ### Moving Panels - We can separate and choose to move the panels as needed, ensuring flexibility in the design process. ```
